description.value: Stallones Kitchen + Bar is a gourmet comfort-food restaurant and cocktail bar in Hope, BC, a natural rest stop for cyclists riding the Fraser Valley corridor. The menu leans on locally sourced, seasonal ingredients with dishes like char-grilled ribeye and garlic prawns alongside craft cocktails and small-batch spirits. The atmosphere is described as rustic and high-energy, aimed at an elevated sit-down dining experience.
